[SWS_CM_99039] Method response message separation time
⌈
If attribute
SomeipMethodDeployment. separationTimeResponse is set, and segmenta-
tion is activated for the corresponding SOME/IP method response message according
to [SWS_CM_99038], the segments shall be separated in time by this value.
